APPROVE
The loop body is split into `JudgeExpressCall` and `ResolveRoute` with the same checks in the same order. The `is not var (path, receiver, middle)` pattern null-checks the nullable tuple before deconstructing it, so the pattern variables are definitely assigned, and the remaining loop and `if` bring `ExpressAndFastify` well under 15 without changing behaviour or the build.
